summary: Phase 1 MVP fully tested. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests PASSED (root, projects CRUD with cascade delete, equipment CRUD with category filter + NDAA, labor-rates defaults+upsert, items CRUD, estimate math). Frontend: Projects empty state, FAB->new project modal, project creation, project detail with estimate summary card, Add Line Item screen, Equipment Library with category chips, Settings labor-rates edit+persist all verified end-to-end via mobile viewport (390x844).

issues: Screen header text 'Add Line Item' collides with screen title; consider adding testID on save CTA. Save CTA is labeled 'Add to Estimate' which differs from typical 'Save Item' - okay but flag for testability.
Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated -> use boxShadow; props.pointerEvents deprecated -> use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking but should be cleaned.

action_items: Add testID attributes to interactive elements for robust E2E coverage: project-name-input, customer-input, site-input, count-cameras/doors/ids-points/intercoms/cable-runs, save-project-btn, add-line-item-btn, item-description-input, item-qty-input, item-unitcost-input, item-hours-input, save-item-btn, labor-rate-<role>-input, save-rates-btn, equipment-* fields.
Replace deprecated 'shadow*' style props with boxShadow and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents to silence RNW warnings.
Optional: align Expo package versions reported by metro (expo 54.0.34 -> 54.0.35, expo-router 6.0.23 -> 6.0.24, expo-font 14.0.11 -> 14.0.12).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is clean (~270 lines), uses async motor, excludes _id, uses uuid ids, validates with Pydantic, returns proper 404s.
Delete project correctly cascades to estimate_items (verified by test_delete_project_cascades_items).
Estimate math validated: material=sum(qty*unit_cost), labor=sum(hours*role_rate), subtotal+OH+profit+contingency all match within 0.01.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of flows reachable; create/list/detail/estimate/settings persistence all verified

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed projects/equipment and clean up after themselves. Manual UI test project was deleted post-run.
